title: Plundered My Soul
original_lyrics:
[verse]
|--5/7--7/9b--11b-11b---11-----------------------------------------------------------------11-----------------------------------------------------------------7/9--9-7----7-7---7---7---7---------------------------------------------9---------9---9------------------------------------------------------------------|

[chorus]
I've been resting on my laurels. I'm bad loser. I'm yard off my pace.
Mmmmm, I smell rubber and I soon discovered that you're gone for good.
My indiscretions made bad impression. Guess I was misunderstood.
I thought you needed my loving, but it's my heart that you stole.
I thought you wanted my money, but you plundered my soul.
(Plundered my soul)

[verse]
I started asking around but your friend's pretty lips were sealed.
I wrote letter full of twaddle and tripe confessions about wounds that heal.
I heard some gossip, you've become an alcoholic, you're dryin' out.
So I phoned every clinic in the yellow pages, not trace I found.

[chorus]
I thought you needed my loving, but it's my heart that you stole.
I thought you wanted my money, but you plundered my soul.
(Plundered my soul)

[verse]
I hate quittin' but I'm close to admittin' I'm sorry case.

[bridge]
You'll be hard act to follow. bitter pill to swallow.
You'll be tough, oh you're tough to replace.

[chorus]
I thought you wanted my loving, but it's my heart that you stole.
You were the trick up my sleeve. My ace in the hole.
I thought you wanted my money, but you plundered my soul.
Oh, plundered my soul.
Oh yeah!
(You plundered my soul)
You plundered my soul.
Yeah! Yeah!
(You plundered my soul)
